desc: The Custom Carry is a hand-fit and assembled pistol built by Colt Custom Shop Master Gunsmiths. Built around an 80 Series Stainless Colt Commander, the Custom Carry features a number of Stan Chen Custom parts, including the Gen2 Magwell, Beavertail Grip Safety, and Full Custom Rear Sight. These pistols are coated in Decobond Smoke Gray coating for a slick corrosion-resistant finish and a pistol that you’ll never want to leave behind.
